ASV read counts can be organised in *wide* format, with one row per ASV and one column per sample, or in *long* format, with one row per ASV–sample combination. The tables below show the same read counts in the two formats.

:::: {.format-compare}
::: {}
**Wide**

| taxonID | sample 1 | sample 2 |
|---|---:|---:|
| ASV a | 620 | 251 |
| ASV b | 14 | 0 |
:::

::: {}
**Long**

| eventID | taxonID | organismQuantity |
|---|---|---:|
| sample 1 | ASV a | 620 |
| sample 1 | ASV b | 14 |
| sample 2 | ASV a | 251 |
:::
::::
